title: Database Objects
description: Build reusable database logic with views, stored procedures, functions, triggers, and indexes. Learn how to encapsulate business rules in the database.
whatYouLearn: How views create saved queries that you can query like tables
How stored procedures package reusable T-SQL logic with parameters
How scalar and table-valued functions encapsulate reusable computations
How triggers automatically respond to data changes
How indexes speed up queries and the difference between clustered and nonclustered indexes
